value.name: hold private yoga class
value.description: Marylin, Sarah, and Ramona are participating in a private yoga session in the plow position.
evidence: Marylin, Sarah and Ramona are in the plow position.

value.name: Vishnu presses on Sarah
value.description: The yoga instructor places his weight on Sarah during the pose, causing her discomfort.
evidence: The yuppie Sikh instructor places his weight on Sarah.
SARAH Vishu! Knock it off. That hurts.

value.name: Vishnu tells Sarah to breathe through pain
value.description: Vishnu dismisses Sarah's complaint and instructs her to keep breathing through the discomfort.

value.name: Marylin focuses on the yoga pose
value.description: Marylin concentrates hard while continuing the yoga exercise.

value.name: Marylin worries about absent man
value.description: Marylin says she does not know where someone is and wants to speak to him because he looked devastated.
evidence: MARYLIN I don't even know where he is. He looked so devastated. If I could just talk to him for a few minutes.

value.name: doorbell interrupts class
value.description: A doorbell rings, interrupting the yoga session and drawing Marylin's attention.
evidence: RAMONA It sounded like a bell.

value.name: Marylin leaves to answer door
value.description: Marylin says she will be right back and exits the class to check the door.
